Three or so strips of cooked bacon appear on the plate. One long strip, one shorter strip, and one that looks partly broken or overlapping. Cooked bacon is about 40-50 kcal per strip and weighs roughly 8-10 g. These strips look thin and crisp, so I estimate 3 strips at about 9 g each, or about 27 g total. At roughly 5.4 kcal/g for crisp bacon, that is about 145 kcal. Since the strips are thin, I'll use a slightly lower figure.
